WITH date_range AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_daily AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           dr.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM web_sales AS ws
    JOIN date_range AS dr ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
store_daily AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           dr.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN date_range AS dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
web_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_daily
),
store_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_daily
),
combined AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN web.item_sk IS NOT NULL THEN web.item_sk ELSE store.item_sk END AS item_sk,
           CASE WHEN web.d_date IS NOT NULL THEN web.d_date ELSE store.d_date END AS d_date,
           web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           store.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM web_v1 AS web
    FULL OUTER JOIN store_v1 AS store
        ON web.item_sk = store.item_sk AND web.d_date = store.d_date
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       web_sales,
       store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           web_sales,
           store_sales,
           MAX(web_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS web_cumulative,
           MAX(store_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM combined
) AS y
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
